sentences.text: No, the 2023 penal charges circular is not the rule to cite today in the loan policy, because the circular was withdrawn and repealed with effect from 2025-11-28 and on 2026-11-23 it is no longer in force.

The documents instead show that UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions, 2025, para 257(3) and para 257(4) apply to this case and state that penal charges are permitted only as per the stated conditions.
The documents do not state whether the loan policy should cite any specific replacement circular by name.

missing.slot: specific replacement circular to cite today
missing.searched: 2023 penal charges circular and the currently applicable rules for penal charges in loan policy
